rule.description: Group entitlement: do not match existing group
rule.comment: When using the Group entitlement with the ILM Manager user application or Role Based Entitlements, groups are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not create groups from DB because the groups are controlled by an entitlement in the vault. Replace this rule with your own matching policy if you want groups to match existing groups in the vault.
